title: Give-Back Ceilings by Payment Record for Retention Concessions, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Give-back ceiling — retention concessions under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.**

| Payments on the agreement in the last 12 months | Give-back ceiling ¹ |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | $15.00 |
| 6 to 9 | $12.00 |
| 5 or fewer | no adjustment under this schedule |

¹ The give-back ceiling is the most a retention concession may give back off the increased rent: the amount worked from the share and the increase is compared with the ceiling and the lower is given back.

Payments are the payment entries on the agreement's ledger dated in the window. A window of the last 12 months covers entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month. Boundaries: 10 payments give $15.00, 9 give $12.00, 6 give $12.00.

Hypothetical readings: a worked give-back of $13.40 on an agreement with 11 payments stands at $13.40; with 7 payments it is held to $12.00.
